items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: But his first cousin George Deku was playing piano with me.

ctx.x: Who was the piano player in your last band? Uh...

Last band we had, uh... I told you that cousin of mine got knocked in a big one. We had a man. I had a woman. I had a woman. She died. Little Odette Davis. She was very good. She was very good. And last I had Walter Deku. Walter Deku played with me too. But his first cousin George Deku was playing piano with me. I remember him. He's there too. He died. He died. He died.
Did you have a trombone in that band? Yes. Any trombone? Yeah.
